source_row.extraction_instructions: Kentico + Blazor; cards are server-prerendered. Walk /events?page=N&start=<today> (the start param is required for page 2, else the unfiltered 100-event archive is returned) until the pager total is reached. Cards give title, dd-mm-yyyy @ hh:mm range and location; event type comes from the title. Detail has a Registration fees block of 'label:' / '£amount' lines.

concerns: The recon said Blazor client-rendering; in fact the cards are prerendered server-side, so Phase A uses fetch_html (httpx first, browser fallback) and is NOT browser-first. Forced-fallback run (httpx 403 on every call) returned the same 19 shells via the browser.

Page 2 only exists as /events?page=2&start=<today>. Without the start param the server returns the unfiltered 100-event archive (mostly past). Walk stops at the pager's 'Showing X to Y of T results' total; a warning is logged if cards read != T.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges read from both ends of 'dd-mm-yyyy @ hh:mm - dd-mm-yyyy @ hh:mm' (capsule course 5 Oct-14 Dec, ESEGH masterclass 16-17 Nov); fees: in-page 'Registration fees' block, 'Course Fee:' line, 'Registrations' block and prose ('free for everyone', 'non-member rate is £75') handled; registration sub-pages are on external booking platforms behind a 'Register' button and were not followed. No image fee tables seen. 7 of 19 events have no public fee (webinars, Project 90 free-for-members sessions that say nothing about non-members, courses whose registration is not open) so pricing_tiers is [] for them; Ulster Project 90 meeting only states a refundable £50 deposit, deliberately not stored as a fee.
Prose fee parsing is deliberately narrow (only 'free for ... members|everyone' and 'non-member ... £N'); a page worded differently yields no tier rather than a guess.
Event type comes from title keywords only (cards show no category). Specialty is fixed to 'Gastroenterology & Hepatology' as in EASL.
The UK place->region map (_UK_PLACES) is imported from ems_calendar.py.
